attributes.board_name: Maryland State Board of Physical Therapy Examiners

rules.accepted_credit_types: CE relevant to physical therapy practice, directed to a professional audience, with written learning outcomes or objectives (1 CE hour = 60 minutes). APTA and FSBPT courses are automatically approved; other courses need Board approval. Credit values: postgraduate PT coursework 10 CE hours per course credit; presenting 2 h per hour; authoring/editing a book, chapter or peer-reviewed article 30 h; abstract 10 h; research 10 h; approved self-directed/home study 1 h per interactive hour; workplace/community service/leadership 1 h once per period; clinical student supervision 10 h once per period (1 h per 40 h).
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal if the original license was issued 1 year or less before the renewal period.
rules.audit_note: A CE form accompanies every renewal application; the Board audits as many licensees as resources allow at the close of the renewal period. Failure to substantiate hours leads to denial of renewal.

topics.who: All licensees: attest to an implicit bias and structural racism training program approved by the Cultural and Linguistic Health Care Professional Competency Program, at the first renewal after April 1, 2026 (Health Occ. §1-225); hours not set by statute

rules.notes: CE hours must be earned between June 1 and May 31 of the 2-year period before renewal; hours completed after May 31 of the renewal year are not accepted. Reinstatement also needs 30 CE hours in the preceding 2 years.
rules.rule_quote: D. A physical therapist shall earn 30 CE hours for the renewal period.
